metadata.title: Platform DNS Resolver Availability and Resilience

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring DNS resolution remains available, resilient, and predictable under failure conditions.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: DNS resolver redundancy, high availability design, fault tolerance, and recovery mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern ensuring DNS resolution does not become a single point of failure for the platform.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Resolver availability and resilience depend on correct zoning and view separation to maintain boundary integrity during failure.

metadata.remarks: Platform DNS Resolver Availability and Resilience defines expectations for redundancy, failover, and predictable failure behavior of DNS resolvers. It ensures that DNS outages or degradation do not silently undermine platform trust.

components.title: DNS Resolver Redundancy
components.description: Ensures multiple independent DNS resolvers are available to prevent single points of failure.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Denial of service caused by reliance on a single DNS resolution endpoint.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Redundant infrastructure components to preserve availability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Redundant DNS resolvers are deployed to support high availability.

components.title: DNS Failure Behavior
components.description: Defines how DNS resolution behaves during partial or complete failure scenarios.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Integrity degradation through unpredictable or silent failure modes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Deterministic failure behavior with defined recovery characteristics.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS services fail in a predictable manner that preserves platform integrity.

components.title: DNS Dependency Resilience
components.description: Ensures DNS resolver dependencies do not introduce cascading or correlated failures.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Supply chain or dependency compromise impacting shared DNS resolution paths.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation and diversification of critical dependencies.

implemented-requirements.remarks: External and internal DNS dependencies are managed to reduce correlated risk.
